previous_statement: At V=sJ the synchronized graph equation has the exact quadratic normal form; it gives G(0)=0, a coarse Lipschitz bound, and after one universal smallness cutoff the sharper estimate ||DG(T)|| <= K_g*r on ||T||<=2r.
new_statement: At V=sJ the synchronized graph equation has the exact quadratic normal form; it gives G(0)=0, a coarse Lipschitz bound, and after one universal smallness cutoff the sharper estimate ||DG(T)|| <= K_g*r for every T in B_{2delta}^{icalH}(0) with ||T||<=2r.
